data.name: Sharad
data.player_statement:
A complete player, Sharad has made a big mark in cricket. With 51 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 52, with an average of 11.83 and a quick strike rate of 129.09. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 46 sixes and 16 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 52.0 overs, taking 31 wickets at an economy rate of 13.06. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
